reason.calendar-timezone-write.title: Update Tau to edit this event's time
reason.calendar-timezone-write.descripti: This event includes timezone information. Your current version only writes local clock time, which would desync the actual scheduled instant across timezones.
reason.calendar-timezone-write.safety: Save was blocked and the original time is preserved. You can still edit and save the title or notes.
reason.calendar-timezone-write.explainTr: Why would saving cause a mismatch?
reason.calendar-timezone-write.explainRo: Updates only the clock time while leaving the stored UTC instant unchanged.
Blocking this write keeps the original schedule intact until you update Tau.
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.title: Update Tau to reschedule this event
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.descriptio: This event includes timezone information. Moving it in this version would only change clock time and conflict with its stored instant.
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.safety: The event was restored to its original slot and your data is intact.
reason.calendar-timezone-drag.explainRow: Changes only clock time without updating the stored timezone and UTC instant.
Canceling the move preserves your original data until you update Tau.
reason.whiteboard-readonly.title: Update Tau to edit this whiteboard
reason.whiteboard-readonly.description: This whiteboard was saved by a newer version of Tau. It is open in read-only mode so newer canvas elements are not overwritten.
reason.whiteboard-readonly.safety: All whiteboard content is preserved and can still be viewed safely.
reason.collaboration-incompatible.title: Update Tau to resume collaboration sync
reason.collaboration-incompatible.descri: The collaboration server now requires a newer protocol version, so syncing is paused in this version.
reason.collaboration-incompatible.safety: Your local edits are safely saved and will sync automatically after updating.
reason.plugin-min-version.title: A newer Tau version is required
reason.plugin-min-version.description: This plugin relies on newer host capabilities. Update Tau before installing or updating it.
reason.plugin-min-version.descriptionWit: This plugin requires Tau v{{version}} or later.
reason.plugin-min-version.safety: Your installed plugins and library data remain unaffected.
reason.db-model-incompatible.title: Update Tau to open this library
reason.db-model-incompatible.description: This library was upgraded by a newer version of Tau on another device. Opening is paused to prevent data corruption.
reason.db-model-incompatible.safety: Your library file is completely intact. Update and restart Tau to open everything as-is.
reason.content-source-unsupported.title: Update Tau to open this content
reason.content-source-unsupported.descri: This item uses a content source introduced in a newer version of Tau.
reason.content-source-unsupported.safety: The original content remains safely stored in your library.
reason.generic.title: Update Tau to continue
reason.generic.description: This action requires data formats or features from a newer version of Tau.
reason.generic.safety: This action was paused and your existing data is preserved.
sub.checking: Checking the update service for the latest version…
sub.available: Your libraries, schedules, and settings are kept automatically.
sub.downloading: Closing this dialog will keep downloading in the background.
sub.ready: Downloaded in the background and ready to install on restart.
sub.upToDate: No newer release was detected in this channel yet. You can download directly from the website.
sub.error: Could not reach the update service. Retry or download the installer manually.
sub.idle: Check for the latest version to continue.
